{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|See that gal there with the white hair? That's Umolly Darm. She ships out Spook crystals, the long green-and-violet kind you find in clusters up in the deep hills. They make some kind of cross-eyed optical equipment that's supposed to make flowers grow better on worlds with K-class suns or something.|[[Arvid Scraf]]|<ref name="PoT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>}}
A '''K-class planet''',<ref name="EGTAS>[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> or '''K-class world''',<ref name="Guide3">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> was a type of [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Nine [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], thousands of [[Tsil]]s, [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]]-based lifeforms from the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], were [[Mining/Legends|mined]] by the [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]]. Officially, the minerals were used in optical equipment to filter the light of K-class planets, but in reality, the Tsils were being used in the company's [[Centrally Controlled Independent Replicant]] technology.<ref name="EGTAS" />
